basic_info.description: Set on a tranquil, tree-lined street in the heart of Noe Valley, this full-floor 2bd/1ba + office/den condominium is situated in a beautiful two-unit building and blends timeless character with thoughtful and modern updates. Upon entering, the spacious living room features bay windows that flood the space with natural light. The generously sized formal dining room provides a perfect space for hosting. The bright, thoughtfully designed kitchen features stone countertops and updated appliances. Two well-appointed bedrooms provide comfort and privacy, while the office/den offers peaceful garden views. The freshly updated split bathroom melds functionality with elegance. Timeless period details such as high ceilings, hardwood floors and crown moulding blend seamlessly with modern updates including a tankless water heater and in-unit laundry. The sunny south-facing shared garden is a lush retreat, anchored by a mature ash tree. A large private storage room and 2-car tandem garage parking round out this fantastic condo.    With a 98 Walk Score, you're just blocks from 24th and Church Street's vibrant shops, cafes, and restaurants, as well as Muni, tech shuttle stops, Dolores Park, and the Noe Valley Farmers Market with easy freeway access for weekend escapes.
